Payout of 27 July is short ₹624.83.
The bank credited ₹10,95,328.82 against an expected ₹10,95,953.65. 22 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000023 of ₹624.83, issued 28 July against payment pay_000179. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000023 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000023 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
